## Konverter Pro Remote MCP Server

Konverter Pro converts German bank statements (PDF, CSV, MT940, camt.053) and payment-provider reports (PayPal, Stripe, SumUp, Shopify) into DATEV, Lexware or MT940 booking files. Every booking is checked against the statement (balances, record counts) before a file is offered.

### Access

Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. Without an API key, jobs are anonymous Single Orders for businesses: a free preview, then payment per job through a Stripe payment link (EUR 0.05 per unit, EUR 1 minimum, plus VAT). With an optional Konverter Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer kp_live_...) the user's plan and accounting profiles apply.

### Workflow

1. `upload_statements` (base64 file or public https link; `buyer_is_business` and `accept_avv` for a new anonymous job)
2. `get_job_status`, `list_open_questions`, `answer_questions`
3. `get_preview` (free DATEV draft) and `get_price_quote`
4. `create_payment_link`, then `download_result`

Privacy: https://konverter-pro.de/en/datenschutz#ai-agents. Terms: https://konverter-pro.de/en/agb.
